commit_message:
fix: support --help flag for subcommands

Add support for displaying help text when --help, -h, or other help flags
are used with subcommands. For example, `cargo xtask bench --help` now
properly displays help for the bench subcommand instead of treating it as
an unknown flag.

The fix integrates help flag detection into the subcommand parsing workflow
in `handle_subcommand_field()`. When a help flag is detected after a
subcommand name, the parser generates subcommand-specific help text using
the existing `generate_subcommand_help()` function and returns it via a
HelpRequested error.

This enables a better user experience where:
- `program --help` shows top-level help
- `program subcommand --help` shows subcommand-specific help
- Nested subcommands like `program sub-one sub-two --help` also work

Fixes #1324
